measurement: Buck release, CPU 16, jobs 1, instructions:u, fresh private store, complete driver interval including publication and teardown; separate perf stat instructions:u covers process startup, dynamic loader, output and exit
basis: Merged b015fdd2 after lazy LLVM bc3c0463; native instructions:u, one sample per corpus at CPU16/jobs1, fresh request store. Re-baseline expected supported-body growth under user instruction, retaining stricter green ceilings and lowering both process ceilings after LLVM startup removal.
margin: 2 percent over the ordinary release observation, rounded up to 100 instructions per code line. Lower ceilings after savings. Re-baseline expected work growth only with reason, completed-body counts and commit range; do not change the fixed finished-process budget.

rebaseline.reason: Expected new checker/emitter support: aggregate constant static reads and specialized generic key equality/hash glue complete additional bodies. This is supported-work growth, not a regression to preserve as a permanent red. bc3c0463 removes LLVM startup mapping; both process ceilings fall.

forecast_method: Current process instructions plus recorded missing checker/emission and publication per line. Live construct self costs project the written population and calibrate to native check/lower less driver keys. Completed IR/template bytes per completed definition line are charged for every unfinished line, retaining partial IR, at measured definition-encoding and archive write/hash rates. Refresh projection/counts when support changes.
regression_policy: Every lane must explain a red guard in its land message: new bodies checked to the end, with before/after count, or a regression to fix. Re-baseline expected support growth with reason and commit range; never raise the fixed 60000 finished-process budget.
